MonoBrowser Mobile 0.2.0

Look and feel
- New motion everywhere: sheets, dialogs and pages animate in and out, the tab grid zooms out of the tab counter, settings pages slide; smooth at high refresh rates
- Predictive back (Android 14+, also Samsung): pages, sheets and dialogs follow the back gesture
- Corners adapt to rounded screens; new start page with clock, most visited and pinned sites, reading list and recently closed tabs
- Menu with the main actions in two rows and "More" for the rest
- Address bar is a plain URL box; type "/" for commands (/newtab, /settings, /print ...), search suggestions, the page stays visible behind the results

Video and music
- Media controls in the notification, lock screen, Now Bar and on the watch, with title, artist and cover art (YouTube, SoundCloud and other sites)
- Background playback, also with the screen off and after switching tabs
- Picture in picture when leaving the app with a video playing, and a floating video window inside the app (drag it to any corner); seek and play/pause buttons in the window

Reading
- Reader view with font options and read aloud (also from the lock screen), "Read later" list that works offline

Downloads
- Progress with percentage in the notification, as a Live Update on Android 16 and in Samsung's Now Bar; blob: downloads

More
- Sync of bookmarks, pinned sites, reading list and notes through a file in your own cloud (Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox ...)
- Home screen search widget, quick settings tile and app shortcuts for private tabs
- Site info sheet (connection, certificate, permissions), desktop mode, text size, translate page, tracking parameters removed from links, dark mode for websites
- Faster: tab thumbnails, start-up, palette search and memory use
- Licence: Apache 2.0 (see NOTICE for the credit requirement)

Install: download `MonoBrowser-0.2.0.apk`, open it and allow installing from your browser/file manager when Android asks. If Google Play Protect asks to scan the app, choose "Scan app" (the app is not in the Play Store, so Google does not know it yet). Optionally verify it against `MonoBrowser-0.2.0.apk.sha256` (`sha256sum -c`).
Requires Android 8.0 or newer. Updating from 0.1.0 keeps your tabs, bookmarks and settings.

Downloads:
- Android: `MonoBrowser-0.2.0.apk` (+ `MonoBrowser-0.2.0.apk.sha256`)
